## AI / Robotics / Semiconductor News

- [Anduril is raising up to $8 billion](https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/03/anduril-aims-at-60-billion-valuation-in-new-funding-round/) at a $60 billion valuation, doubling its previous round and signaling strong investor confidence in defense AI and robotics despite regulatory headwinds.
- [Apple launched new MacBook Pro and Air models with M5 chips](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/03/apple-macbook-prices-m5-ai.html), raising prices up to $400 amid a global RAM shortage and emphasizing AI-centric performance to compete in the premium hardware segment.
- [Claude Code introduced a voice mode feature](https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/03/claude-code-rolls-out-a-voice-mode-capability/) for its AI coding assistant, supporting hands-free workflows and contributing to Anthropic’s reported $2.5 billion run-rate revenue and rapid user growth.
- [Anthropic’s Claude became the most popular iPhone app](https://edition.cnn.com/2026/03/03/tech/anthropic-claude-ai-app-pentagon) following a Pentagon-related controversy, highlighting significant market traction and competitive positioning in AI-driven communication tools.
- [Elliott Management took a $1 billion stake in Pinterest](https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/03/activist-investor-elliott-takes-a-1b-stake-in-pinterest-betting-on-ai-driven-growth/), betting on AI-driven growth and underscoring investor confidence in AI’s transformative potential for digital platforms.
- [AI companies and VCs spent over $125 million](https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/03/ai-companies-are-spending-millions-to-thwart-this-former-tech-execs-congressional-bid/) to oppose a congressional candidate advocating for AI regulation, highlighting the strategic importance of regulatory influence for sector investments.
- [Alibaba’s Qwen AI tech lead stepped down](https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/03/alibabas-qwen-tech-lead-steps-down-after-major-ai-push/) shortly after launching high-performing Qwen 3.5 models, raising questions about the company’s innovation trajectory amid global AI competition.
- [Qualcomm’s CEO projected robotics as a trillion-dollar opportunity](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/03/qualcomm-ceo-robotics-chips.html) by 2040-2050, following the launch of its Dragonwing robotics processor and signaling increased investment focus on AI-driven robotics hardware.
- [VisionSight completed a B1 funding round](https://36kr.com/p/3706859579486597) led by Hefei Luzhou No.1 Industrial Fund to accelerate AI industry application deployment in smart transportation and urban management.
- [Laimang Biotech raised nearly 200 million yuan](https://36kr.com/p/3707151883382917) to advance AI-powered metabolic-enhanced CAR-T cell therapies, reflecting strong investor interest in AI-driven biotech innovation.
- [Carpower secured $100 million in Series B funding](https://36kr.com/p/3706987145867397) led by Horizon and Didi for scaling autonomous truck deployment, with over 400 trucks already operating and plans for 1,000 more this year.

- [Shenzhen Lingchai Cloud completed Series C+ funding](https://36kr.com/p/3590663070384392) at a valuation above 1 billion yuan, doubling revenue and leading global sales in humanoid robot joints for industrial and healthcare automation.
- [AI tactile vest 'HeFeng' received angel funding](https://pitchhub.36kr.com/project/3705719176659721) to advance explosion and impact sensing for VR, gaming, and medical applications, highlighting investor interest in AI-driven wearable tech.
- [Chinese semiconductor sector faces new U.S. export restrictions](https://www.caixinglobal.com/2026-03-03/chinese-tech-exports-hit-by-us-restrictions-102418744.html), disrupting supply chains and potentially hindering technological advancement and investment prospects in China’s chip industry.

- [AI startups are using multi-tiered valuation strategies](https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/03/why-ai-startups-are-selling-the-same-equity-at-two-different-prices/) within funding rounds, creating headline unicorn valuations but increasing risk of down rounds and valuation resets.
- [Cloud computing infrastructure developments for AI](https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/03/cloud-computing-infrastructure-developments-for-ai/) are strengthening competitive positioning among major tech firms and driving market growth in AI and cloud sectors.
- [X will suspend creators for unlabeled AI-generated armed conflict videos](https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/03/x-says-it-will-suspend-creators-from-revenue-sharing-program-for-unlabeled-ai-posts-of-armed-conflict/), reflecting ongoing regulatory efforts to mitigate AI misuse and impacting content monetization strategies.
